name: Caverton
source: CRON 20261014: Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc unaudited consolidated statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Group column, thousands of naira scaled to naira. Revenue less the operating expenses line equals the line the filing labels Operating Profit, and that less administrative expenses plus net exchange difference plus other operating income equals the printed Total Operating Profit/(Loss); that total less net finance cost equals the printed profit before income tax and less the printed income tax equals the printed loss for the period. The filing has no cost of sales line, so the operating expenses line is stored as Cost of Sales and the line the filing labels Operating Profit is stored as Gross Profit. EPS in naira per share. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | Cost of Sales stored as 0.0 against a non-zero Revenue was replaced by Revenue minus Gross Profit (FY2024, FY2025); the zero was a failed parse, not a figure | CRON 2026-10-06: 3 blank cell(s) filled from https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ngx/CAVERTON/financials/income-statement/ . Every value this file already stored agreed with that page within 0.5%, so the fill is additive. Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit were re-checked per period; Net Profit was withheld where the source's own figures do not tie. | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc unaudited statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, group year to September column, printed in N thousand and stored as absolute naira. Revenue 20,736,093; operating expenses 11,865,435 plus administrative expenses 12,760,527 gives operating expenses 24,625,962; net exchange difference 1,692,341 and other operating income 55,867 printed above the total; total operating loss 2,253,395; net finance cost 11,492,284; loss before income tax 13,745,679; income tax 47,700; loss for the period 13,793,379; basic EPS printed as 4.12 negative naira. Ties exactly. | CRON 20261120_0501: 9M 2026 cells from the issuer Q3 2026 filing in the NGX doclib library (doclib.ngxgroup.com), entity and period column named in the note. EPS None to -4.08. | CRON 20261120: FY2025 and FY2024 corrected against the audited annual reports in the NGX filing library. FY2025 AFS page 12 prints revenue 24,102,731, cost of sales 11,956,370, gross profit 12,146,361, administrative expenses 28,986,545, operating profit 3,601,509, finance income 358,115, finance costs 18,639,361, share of associate 806,802, loss before tax 13,872,935, income tax 13,770, loss after tax 13,886,705 (NGN thousands). The file had carried a profit before tax of 50,218,037 thousand and a net profit of 50,231,807 thousand for FY2025, which the audited statement does not support: FY2025 was a loss year. FY2024: the FY2024 AFS page 23 prints loss before tax 53,670,583, income tax 191,537, loss after tax 53,862,120, administrative expenses 10,328,093, finance costs 22,932,744 and finance income 54,473; the file had 54,958,294 for both profit before tax and net profit. FY2023 comparatives from the same page: loss before tax 12,685,933, income tax 61,504, loss after tax 12,747,437. Income tax is stored positive as a charge, the dataset convention, so the two loss years carry a positive tax cell. Sources: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47443_CAVERTON_OFFSHORE_SUPPORT_GROUP_PLC-_QUARTER_5_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2025_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf and https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/43565_CAVERTON_OFFSHORE_SUPPORT_GROUP_PLC-_QUARTER_5_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2024_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_MARCH_2025.pdf | CRON 20261120 (9M 2026): Operating Expenses sign corrected from -24,625,962,000 to +24,625,962,000. It is a magnitude row and the figure is the printed operating expenses 11,865,435 plus administrative expenses 12,760,527 from the Q3 2026 statement, page 2. The stored EBIT of -2,253,395,000 is correct as filed: revenue 20,736,093 less those expenses less other operating income 55,867 plus net exchange difference 1,692,341 equals the printed total operating profit of -2,253,395, and that less net finance cost 11,492,284 gives the printed loss before tax of 13,745,679. https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/48292_CAVERTON_OFFSHORE_SUPPORT_GROUP_PLC-_QUARTER_3_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_OCTOBER_2026.pdf

unitGuard.reason: unit guard refused: the EPS for 9M 2026 reads -4120 and the earnings triangle would put it at -4.12 (a factor of 1001), but that triangle rests on a net profit of 5.02318e+10 against a market capitalisation of 1.474e+10 (3.408x of FY2025), so the row that is in the wrong unit is the EARNINGS row and not the EPS row. Both are left exactly as filed; the guard does not pick between them.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
